_what: Where each proprioception fixture came from. VERIFIED = captured from the named machine's real tool output. FORMAT = the tool's documented/published output format with illustrative values, NOT captured on that machine; replace with a real capture when the machine runs `python3 -m sage.gateway.proprioception --json` (see the PR's run block).

two_gpu_nvidia_smi.csv.basis: nvidia-smi --query-gpu CSV, nounits; '[N/A]' is what nvidia-smi prints for an unsupported field

thor_nvidia_smi.csv.basis: same CSV; memory.used/total print [N/A] on unified-memory NVIDIA parts (assumed for Thor, unverified)

thor_nvidia_smi_apps.csv.basis: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=gpu_bus_id,used_memory CSV; one numeric row and one [N/A] row

orin_tegrastats.txt.basis: tegrastats line layout on Orin under JetPack 6 (timestamp prefix, RAM a/bMB, GR3D_FREQ n%, name@tempC, VDD rails)

thor_tegrastats.txt.basis: Orin layout applied to Thor's 14 cores and 128 GB; the GPU load field on Thor is UNKNOWN, so this line deliberately has no GR3D_FREQ (tests the gap path)

macos_vm_stat.txt.basis: vm_stat output layout on Apple Silicon (16384-byte pages)

macos_ioreg_accel.txt.basis: ioreg -r -d 1 -w 0 -c IOAccelerator on Apple Silicon: PerformanceStatistics with 'Device Utilization %' and 'In use system memory'

macos_sysctl_hw_memsize.txt.basis: sysctl -n hw.memsize for a 16 GB machine (McNugget's documented RAM)

amd_smi_metric.json.basis: amd-smi metric --json, ROCm 6.1+ list form with {value, unit}

amd_smi_metric_gpu_data.json.basis: amd-smi metric --json wrapped in gpu_data with bare numbers (other ROCm releases)

cbp_meminfo_large_cache.txt.cmd: cat /proc/meminfo (WSL2 guest; Cached+Buffers ~16.6 GiB vs AnonPages ~4.2 GiB)

win_host_no_vmmem.json.basis: cbp_win_host.json with vm emptied: the case where vmmem is not visible to the Windows user
